intro: Everything between the game and the stream. Each line is one part of the setup; follow it from source to screen.

lines.name: Audio
lines.summary: Broadcast mic into a dedicated XLR interface, closed-back cans for monitoring.

items.name: Shure SM7B
items.note: Dynamic broadcast mic. Forgiving of room noise and keyboard clatter.

items.name: Elgato Wave XLR
items.note: Powers the SM7B and handles gain, with tap-to-mute on top.

items.name: Beyerdynamic DT 770 Pro
items.note: Closed-back, so game audio stays out of the mic.

lines.name: Video & capture
lines.summary: Mirrorless camera for the facecam, two capture cards, one key light.

pc.name: The PC
pc.summary: One machine for playing, encoding and streaming.
